caption: The drawing depicts two metallic, L-shaped tools positioned side by side against a pale, beige background. Each tool has a hollow, cylindrical handle attached to a flat, broad blade that forms an approximately right angle to the handle. The tool on the left is shown in a perspective that emphasizes its curved handle and the thin, tapering edge of the blade. The tool on the right displays more of the blade's surface, which appears darker and features subtle textural variations suggesting reflections or wear. Both objects are rendered in shades of gray, with varying degrees of shading to indicate their three-dimensional form and metallic surface. The overall composition places the objects slightly off-center with ample blank space around them, and there are no other objects or decorative elements in the drawing.
title: Amana Dough Trough Scrapers
